snippet.title: Planet Killer | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Planet Killer is finally here, releasing on Steam on 9/9/26.

Planet Killer is a physics-driven sci-fi destruction roguelite. Orbit hostile worlds, unleash devastating weapons, and carve real craters into fully simulated planets while escalating planetary defenses fight back.

Get Planet Killer here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4454430/Planet_Killer/

Fully simulated destructible planets

Real-time crater carving and shockwaves

Chain explosions and cascading destruction

Every shot leaves a permanent impact

Terrain fractures. Defenses collapse. Worlds crumble beneath sustained bombardment.
